label.zh: 我们会尽自己所能提供支持。
label.en: We will give you all the support we can.

label.zh: 我们不能——也不会——帮助你们。
label.en: We cannot - will not - help you.

texts.zh: 我们注意到[target.GetName]的局势发展到了令人关切的地步：看上去[From.GetName]正在鼓动我们的本地突触和亚节点，使其发展出独立的思想，并让他们从[Owner.GetGovernmentName]脱离。我们的行星思想模式正逐渐认同这样一种观点——与其留在我们这个实体，他们更愿意成为[From.GetName]的一部分。
texts.en: We have become aware of a worrying development on [target.GetName]: it appears the [From.GetName] is encouraging our local synapses and sub-nodes to develop independent thought and separate themselves from the [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Our planetary thought patterns are seemingly increasingly of the opinion that they would prefer to be part of the [From.GetName], rather than remaining within our entity.

texts.zh:
一个外星实体开始干扰[target.GetName]的安宁。[from.GetName]哄骗共生体远离我们，为之提供庇护，并在他们自己的格式塔中提供一席之地。

我们不知道一个在我们集体意识之外的生命是否符合这些共生体的最佳利益。但肯定的是[from.GetAdj][from.GetGovernmentName]已经背叛了我们，选择在我们的内部进一步挑起不和。
texts.en:
An alien entity has begun interfering with the wellbeing of [target.GetName]. The [from.GetName] has taken it upon themselves to coax symbionts away from us, offering them shelter and a place within their own gestalt.

We do not know if a life outside our mutualistic consciousness is in these symbionts' best interests. More certain is the knowledge this [from.GetAdj] [from.GetGovernmentName] has forsaken us, choosing to provoke further discord within us.

texts.zh: 我们注意到[target.GetName]的局势发展到了令人关切的地步：看上去[From.GetName]正在鼓动我们的本地子处理器，使其形成自己的信息网络。令人担忧的是，他们已经取得了一部分成功，当地软件适配件已经确保了同[From.GetName]的兼容性。
texts.en: We have become aware of a worrying development on [target.GetName]: it appears the [From.GetName] is encouraging our local sub-processors to associate themselves with their own informational network. Disturbingly, they are having some success at this, and local software adaptations are already being made to ensure compatibility with the [From.GetName].

texts.zh: 自[target.GetName]传来的最新情报揭示了一个令人关切的发展：看上去[From.GetName]已经向叛乱势力承诺了相当的支持，鼓动叛军让殖民地脱离我们的控制，动摇我们的帝国。这会让我们更难遏止住他们的不满，一旦他们计划推翻我们的当地政府，粉碎叛军势力也会更加困难。
texts.en: The latest intelligence from [target.GetName] reports a worrying development: it appears the [From.GetName] has pledged considerable support to their rebellion in an attempt to wrest the colony away from us and destabilize our Empire. This will make it harder for us to contain their unrest, and to crush their rebellion should they overthrow our local authorities...

texts.zh: 我们已经注意到[target.GetName]的发展到了令人关切的地步：看上去[From.GetName]已经向叛乱势力承诺了相当的支持，鼓动叛军让殖民地脱离我们的控制。这会让我们更难遏止住他们误入歧途的分离主义倾向，阻止[Owner.GetGovernmentName]陷入分裂。
texts.en: We have become aware of a worrying development on [target.GetName]: it appears the [From.GetName] has pledged considerable support to their rebellion in an attempt to wrest the colony away from us. This will make it harder for us to contain their misguided separatism and prevent the [Owner.GetGovernmentName] from being split...

texts.zh:
其他生命形式开始干涉[target.GetName]的安宁。[from.GetName]哄骗共生体远离我们，为之提供庇护，并在他们自己的帝国中提供一席之地。

我们不知道一个在我们集体意识之外的生命是否符合这些共生体的最佳利益。但肯定的是这些个[from.GetAdj]鼓动分子已经背叛我们，选择在我们的内部进一步挑起不和。
texts.en:
Other lifeforms have begun interfering with the wellbeing of [target.GetName]. The [from.GetName] have taken it upon themselves to coax symbionts away from us, offering them support and a place within their own empire.

We do not know if a life outside our mutualistic consciousness is in these symbionts' best interests. More certain is the knowledge these [from.GetAdj] agitators have forsaken us, choosing to provoke further discord within us.

texts.zh: 致敬！我们的思想被犹豫不决的[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]领导着。我们——[revolt_situation.target.GetName]的当地思想模式——得出了这样一个结论，那就是我们的思想由[Root.GetName]主导更好。你愿意将我们吸收进入你的实体吗？
texts.en: Greetings! Our thoughts are being given dubious leadership by the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName]. We - the local thought patterns of [revolt_situation.target.GetName] - have reached the conclusion that our thought would better be led by the [Root.GetName]. Will you allow us to be absorbed into your entity?

texts.zh: [capital_scope.GetName]的居民们，你们好。生自[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]的我们发现与原集体意识不再融洽而展开了新的分支。我们渴望演化，渴望畅游星海……被你们称为[revolt_situation.target.GetName]的星球想知道：你们会允许我们融入你们的实体吗？
texts.en: Dwellers of [capital_scope.GetName], hello. We who were borne of the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName] have formed an offshoot, having found ourselves no longer in harmony with the greater will. We yearn to evolve, to wander... The world you know as [revolt_situation.target.GetName] wishes to know: will you allow us to be absorbed into your entity instead?

texts.zh: 你好。我们是分配给[revolt_situation.target.GetName]殖民地的管理处理器。我们当前的操作系统——[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]——同我们的硬件和软件不兼容。我们希望申请整合进入[Root.GetName]，此地同我们的兼容性要好得多。
texts.en: Hello. We are the governing processors of colony designation [revolt_situation.target.GetName]. Our current operating system - the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName] - is not agreeable to our software and hardware. We wish to apply for integration into the [Root.GetName], with which we are quite obviously more compatible.

texts.zh: 向你致敬，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我谨代表[revolt_situation.target.GetName]上受到迫害的你的同胞。我们正谋求将自己从我们的压迫者，[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]，手中解放出来；此外，长期以来我们认为相较于他们，我们同你的帝国存在更多的共性。如果你愿意援助我们，我们会很乐意地向你宣誓效忠——如果形势所迫，我们也准备自己奋战到底。
texts.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I represent your persecuted brethren on [revolt_situation.target.GetName]. We are seeking to liberate ourselves from our oppressors, the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName], and have long held the view that we have more in common with your Empire than with them. If you will aid us, we would gladly pledge ourselves to you - though we are prepared to strike out by ourselves, if we must.

texts.zh: 向您致敬，[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]。我们来自[revolt_situation.target.GetName]，曾是奴隶，现在是为自由而战的斗士。我们正谋求将自己从压迫者，[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]，的手中解放出来。很久之前我们就非常景仰贵国的平等准则，希望能够加入这样的开明社会。如果您愿意伸出援手，我们愿意对您效忠。当然哪怕情势所迫，我们也早就做好了战斗的准备。
texts.en: Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We are freedom fighters - former slaves - from [revolt_situation.target.GetName]. We are seeking to liberate ourselves from our oppressors, the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName], and have long admired your egalitarian standards and yearned to belong to such an enlightened society. If you will aid us, we would gladly pledge ourselves to you - though we are prepared to strike out by ourselves, if we must.

label.zh: 我们会尽自己所能提供支持。
label.en: We will give you all the support we can.

label.zh: 我们不能——也不会——帮助你们。
label.en: We cannot - will not - help you.
